label: Infection
source: Guide for Physicians on Level of Care: Infection that failed outpatient treatment

inputs.label: Continued deterioration despite more than 24 hours of therapy
Unable to tolerate or absorb oral anti-infection treatment

prerequisites.failText: The guide's infection criteria apply to an infection that failed outpatient treatment. For other infections use clinical judgment, or choose a more specific condition such as Pneumonia.

any.text: Continued deterioration despite more than 24 hours of therapy
Temperature has persisted for {value} weeks (3 or more, FUO)
Unable to tolerate or absorb oral anti-infection treatment

observationText: No inpatient criteria met. The guide gives no separate observation criteria for infection, so use physician judgment.
